plan.hypothesis: If tarball with member '../escaped.txt' reaches install without the relevant check, the safe property fails: The install raises ArgumentError for the member, and after the call dir/escaped.txt does not exist

control.seam: require 'theme_installer' and call the real ThemeInstaller.install on a StringIO tarball
control.property_to_assert: Returns 1 and dir/theme/css/site.css contains the sentinel Observed by: File.read of dir/theme/css/site.css in the fixture after the real install call

citations.quote:
def self.install(io, dest)
    count = 0
    Gem::Package::TarReader.new(io) do |tar|
      tar.each do |entry|
        next unless entry.file?

        target = File.join(dest, entry.full_name)
        FileUtils.mkdir_p(File.dirname(target))
        File.binwrite(target, entry.read)
